verdict.rationale: A user-facing AI-training opt-out is a fair privacy-posture question for a government filing service, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only site-wide robots.txt crawl blocks: a blanket 'Disallow: /' on the SCC hosts, plus a named GPTBot ban on a different agency's host (Virginia Tax). Those are adjacent site-level controls, not a documented user control or policy preventing a filer's data from being used for AI training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
